notASogverseRoom: This session isn't held in a Sogverse voice room. Go back to see how to join it.
zonesDescription: Tap or drag yourself onto a zone to move in. You hear everyone in the same zone.
makePrivateHint: Only moderators can place gamers here, and their audio and video stay completely private.
deleteZoneDescription: Anyone in this zone moves back to the clubhouse.

mediaError.denied: We can’t access your microphone or camera. If you blocked access, allow it in your browser’s site settings, then reload.
mediaError.no-device: No microphone or camera was found. Connect one, then reload.
mediaError.in-use: Your microphone or camera is being used by another app or browser tab. Close it, then reload.
mediaError.insecure: Camera and microphone need a secure (https) connection.
mediaError.interrupted: Your microphone has stopped sending sound. Check that it’s connected and not muted on your device, then pick it again in the list or reload.
mediaError.unknown: We couldn’t access your microphone or camera. Reload and try again.

instant.joinFailed: Couldn’t join the room. Please try again.

share.hint: Click the link to copy it.

lobby.title: Ready to join?
lobby.description: Check your camera and microphone before stepping in.

end.guestDescription: You can rejoin any time using the same link, until the room ends.
end.modDescription: You can leave on your own, or end the call for everyone — that disconnects every participant and closes the room.

ended.title: Call ended
ended.body: The room is closed. Thanks for joining.

left.title: You left the call
left.body: The room is still open — use the link to come back any time.

notFound.title: Room not found
notFound.body: We couldn’t find a voice room with this code:
notFound.hint: Double-check the code for typos. Letters and numbers must match exactly.

createPage.title: Spin up an instant voice room
createPage.subtitle: One tap → fresh room & shareable link to send. Use it for impromptu 1-on-1s, or co-gedu coordination outside or in addition to the scheduled session.
createPage.createFailed: Couldn’t create a room. Please try again.

feedback.heading: How did it go?

items.geduKnowledgeable: My Gedu was knowledgeable and helpful.
items.geduKind: My Gedu was friendly and kind.
items.groupListens: My group listens to and understands me.

feedback.notePrompt: Anything else you want to tell us about today’s session?
feedback.audience: Your Gedu and the School of Gaming team will read your feedback. Thank you!
feedback.saveFailed: Your answers were not saved. Press Done to try again.

zoneSaveFailed: That zone didn’t save. Try again.
